stories.title: Dira Signal is live: what matters, verified
stories.summary: We may not always be first. We aim to be the place you check to know whether something is true and what it means.

brief.what_happened: Dira Signal, an independent news and information platform focused on Kenya and Africa, has launched.
verified: Every story is published only after its core facts are confirmed.
Each story lists the sources it rests on.
brief.why_it_matters: Kenyans are flooded with viral claims. We separate what is confirmed from what is not.
brief.whats_next: Verified reporting across Kenya, Business, Society, Technology, Infrastructure, Lifestyle, Sports and World, plus Fact Checks and Explainers.

body: Every Dira Signal story answers the same questions: what actually happened, what has been verified, who is involved, why it matters and what happens next.
A story goes up only when two independent sources confirm it, an official source is on the record, or we reported it first-hand.
When we get something wrong, we fix it openly and log it on our Corrections page. Have a tip? Send it to us and we'll check it before we report it.
